title: Warm Glow & Hands at the Chin
prompt: An original young woman with dark hair in a loose low bun and soft face-framing strands rests her chin on her folded hands. She wears a white oversized top with billowing sleeves and a brown strap at the shoulder. Her gaze is direct, with a subtle, sultry expression. Warm amber light falls across her face against a soft, blurred background. Palette of amber, cream, and deep brown. Intimate and warm, in the style of a beauty campaign.
workingNotes:
- The hand position and warm light create the intimate tone.
- Add 'soft focus' for a dreamy effect.
